name: MME (Labor & Packing)
language_source: English-language reviews and Florida market; default for English-speaking Florida business

verification_notes.website_check: gmaps_detail.js / gmaps_detail2.js returned website: null, and the Google Maps page itself showed an 'Add website' suggestion (no website set on the Google Business Profile). Tried https://mme-labor-and-packing.com and other naive domain variants: no DNS record (connect_unreachable). The business's own Google Photos include two old promotional flyers referencing https://mmemoving.com and https://www.mmemovingpros.com as a past website; both domains currently fail to resolve (mmemoving.com: ENOTFOUND / no DNS) or redirect to an expired-domain marketplace (mmemovingpros.com -> expireddomains.com), confirming no live own website today. Facebook page (facebook.com/mme1transport1movers) is login-gated and could not be verified further.
verification_notes.phone_source: Not shown on the Google Maps listing itself (page showed 'Add place's phone number'). Verified independently from two first-party Google Photos uploaded by the business itself, both displaying 'Call now for your free quote 239-465-5466' alongside the MME Moving & Transporting logo. Cross-checked against two third-party moving directories (greatguysmoving.com / greatguysmove.com and localmovers.com) that both list the identical phone number AND the identical Google rating/review count (4.6, 28 reviews) as this exact Google Maps profile, confirming the match.
verification_notes.address_source: Not available. Third-party directories conflict (localmovers.com lists 3592 Broadway Ste 130, Fort Myers, FL 33901; greatguysmove.com lists 460 Wilma Ave, Fort Myers, FL 33905) and neither could be cross-verified against an official record, so no street address is used anywhere in the site per the no-invented-data rule. The Google Maps profile itself shows no address (likely a service-area business).
